[SWS_UCM_00029] Consistency Check of Manifest
⌈
UCM
shall validate the content
of the manifest against the schema defined for the meta-data(eg: for missing parameter
or for value out of range of the parameter) and shall raise the
ApplicationError
InvalidPackageManifest
if it finds discrepancies there.
⌋
(RS_UCM_00012)
